name: halo
description: Halo: a declarative language for AI workflows

scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc --noEmit && bunx tsc -p studio/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc -p tsconfig.tooling.json
scripts.build:vsx: bun build src/lsp/server.ts --target node --outfile editors/vscode/server.js && cd editors/vscode && npm run compile
scripts.package:vsx: bun run build:vsx && cd editors/vscode && bunx vsce package
scripts.site:dev: bun site/build.ts --no-tests && bunx wrangler dev --config site/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.site:deploy: bun site/build.ts && bunx wrangler deploy --config site/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.registry:dev: bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply halo-registry --local --config services/registry/wrangler.jsonc && bunx wrangler dev --local --config services/registry/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.registry:deploy: bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply halo-registry --remote --config services/registry/wrangler.jsonc && bunx wrangler deploy --config services/registry/wrangler.jsonc
